{{Top|leg}}
The '''fire suppression system''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] utility item that had been designed to douse flames and cool critically overheating systems. The chemical compounds employed in this device were similar to those used in [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbonite freezing]], thereby producing a chemical stream cold enough to be used as an improvised weapon.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.
